title: DRScaffold: Boosting Dense-Scene Reasoning in Lightweight Vision Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.26038v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Lightweight vision-language models perform competitively on standard benchmarks yet fail systematically in dense-scene reasoning, where multiple objects, attributes, and relations must be jointly grounded and resolved through multi-step inference. Such capability is critical for real-world applications where models must reliably interpret cluttered environments. Yet existing training signals provide no explicit grounding between reasoning steps and the underlying visual entities and relations, leaving lightweight models free to generate fluent but visually unanchored reasoning chains. translated_title: DRScaffold：提升轻量级视觉语言模型在密集场景中的推理能力
translated_abstract: 轻量级视觉语言模型在标准基准测试中表现具有竞争力，但在密集场景推理中却会系统性地失败——在这种场景下，需要通过多步推理同时对多个对象、属性和关系进行联合定位与解析。这种能力对于现实世界的应用至关重要，因为模型需要可靠地解读杂乱的环境。然而，现有的训练信号没有在推理步骤与底层视觉实体和关系之间提供显式的定位关联，使得轻量级模型可以自由地生成流畅但缺乏视觉依据的推理链。为了解决这一空白，我们首先引入了DRBench，这是一个包含跨越2,943张图像的14,573个问题的基准，组织为五个任务类别，涵盖三个渐进式的推理层次。基于DRBench，我们提出了DRScaffold，这是一个监督微调框架，它将监督目标分解为四个因果有序的阶段，促进……
tldr: 该论文提出了密集场景推理基准DRBench以及监督微调框架DRScaffold，通过将监督目标分解为四个因果有序的阶段，在推理步骤与视觉实体之间建立显式定位关联，从而提升轻量级视觉语言模型在密集场景中的多步推理能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DRBench, a dense-scene reasoning benchmark, and DRScaffold, a supervised fine-tuning framework that decomposes supervision into four causally ordered stages to explicitly ground reasoning steps in visual entities, thereby boosting dense-scene reasoning in lightweight vision-language models.
